subject: Co-host concurrency: need to deconflict partner + SI marketplace demo
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@cloudintegrator.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-partner-ps@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Co-hosting marketplace demo — potential overlap with AWS SI

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re lining up a 60-minute co-sell demo for CloudIntegrator + Redwood to present at the AWS Marketplace showcase on Sept 20. AWS has assigned an SI engineer to do the deep-dive at 10:00 PT, but we just learned your APAC SDRs are trying to book a complementary session during the same site-wide block. That could create conflicts for attendees and for the SI resource.

Can we confirm whether Redwood can:
- take the 09:00 PT slot (APAC-friendly follow-on) or shift to 11:30 PT as a fallback
- provide a technical co-host for the SI portion (30m) and a product owner for Q&A

Attached is the runbook draft we shared with AWS — it shows the proposed handoff and slide deck order (attachment: CloudIntegrator_runbook_v1.pdf).

We’d like to lock time this week so AWS can publish the session in the marketplace calendar. Proposed windows (PT): 09:00-10:00, 10:00-11:00, 11:30-12:30. Which works best for Redwood?

Cheers,
Maya Singh
Head of Partnerships, CloudIntegrator
maya@cloudintegrator.io
+1 (415) 555-0129
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@cloudintegrator.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Co-hosting marketplace demo — potential overlap with AWS SI

Hi Maya — thanks for flagging this. Quick answers up front: we can cover the 09:00 PT window and provide a technical co-host for the SI segment; 11:30 PT is also acceptable if 09:00 collides with other internal commitments.

Two requests from our side:
- Can AWS confirm whether their SI will need to lead the first 30 minutes (arch + integration) or the middle 30 minutes (hands-on/live inference)? That affects which Redwood engineer should join.
- Can you attach the latest slide deck (speaker notes) and the AWS market blurb so we can sanity-check transitions?

Proposed next steps:
1) Lock 09:00 PT as primary, 11:30 PT as fallback.
2) Vanessa here will be our APAC-friendly host if we pick 09:00 PT; Karthik will run the rehearsal.

I’m pulling Vanessa and Karthik into this thread to confirm availability for rehearsal windows next week (we typically do a 45-minute dry run).

Thanks — KM

—
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Co-hosting marketplace demo — potential overlap with AWS SI

Vanessa / Karthik — forwarding Maya’s note. Short ask: can you confirm the following by EOD?
- Vanessa: available to be technical co-host on Sept 20 at 09:00 PT (this would be APAC-friendly for our SE in Bangalore) — if not, can you take 11:30 PT instead?
- Karthik: can you run the rehearsal on Sept 17 or 18 (45 min), and prepare a 10-slide rapid checklist for handoff (1 slide each: infra, latency expectations, KV cache notes, quantization/precision caveats, failover policy)?

If either of you are blocked, I’ll propose an alternate from ops. AWS will want the confirmed host by Friday so they can publish.

Thanks for the quick coordination everyone. Confirming we’ll lock the primary session for Sept 20, 09:00-10:00 PT. AWS confirmed their SI will lead the integration deep-dive in the middle 30 minutes and asked that Redwood own the opening 10 minutes (context + product positioning) and the final 20 minutes (Q&A + next steps).

Attachments: I’ve attached the updated runbook (CloudIntegrator_runbook_v2.pdf) with the timing map and slide callouts. I’ve also shared the public marketplace blurb (copy for AWS listing).

Rehearsal: Sept 17 at 08:30 PT works for us for a 45-minute dry-run. Vanessa — thanks for taking lead on co-hosting. Karthik — appreciate the checklist; if you can drop the deck into the shared drive link below by EOD Monday we’ll incorporate.

Links and notes:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/491827/D-4921-CI
- Rehearsal invite (calendar): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudintegrator-demo-20270917
